gcp.nat.data_processed.note: Public NAT: data processed by the gateway, inbound and outbound (per GiB). The same in every region. From the pricing page; sync verifies it against the Billing Catalog once credentials are set.

gcp.nat.gateway_hour_capped.note: Public NAT gateway uptime serving more than 32 VM instances: the hourly charge stops growing here. From the pricing page; sync verifies it against the Billing Catalog once credentials are set.

gcp.nat.ip_hour.note: Each static or ephemeral external IP address a Public NAT gateway uses, an hour. From the pricing page; sync verifies it against the Billing Catalog once credentials are set.

gcp.nat.private.data_processed.note: Private NAT: data processed by the gateway, inbound and outbound (per GiB). From the pricing page; sync verifies it against the Billing Catalog once credentials are set.

gcp.nat.private.gateway_hour.note: Private NAT gateway uptime. From the pricing page; sync verifies it against the Billing Catalog once credentials are set.

gcp.nat.vm_hour.note: Public NAT gateway uptime: this much an hour for each VM instance that gets a NAT assignment, up to 32. The same in every region. From the pricing page; sync verifies it against the Billing Catalog once credentials are set.
